verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own tokenization solution, which pushes Visa and Mastercard credit, debit and prepaid cards into Apple Pay, Google Pay and other digital wallets. However, nothing in the evidence shows tokens exposed as first-class objects that can be listed, attributed to a wallet or merchant, or managed. Missing for 10: API or dashboard to list the tokens created for a card, identification of which wallet or merchant holds each token, and token-level suspend/revoke independent of the PAN.
